purpose: Prevent the shared token GEX/Gex from creating false lineage edges between unrelated JANUS branches.

GEX_GAMMA_EXPOSURE.definition: gradient-volatility proxy derived from grad_norm relative to grad_norm_ema
GEX_GAMMA_EXPOSURE.observed_runtime_action: positive threshold reduces lr_scale; negative threshold slightly increases lr_scale; lr_scale is clamped

GEX_GAME_CHARACTER.identity: Gex the Gecko / THE GREEN CHANNEL

CORE_GEX.rule: Do not create this node by concatenating nearby Core and GEX mentions.

historical_training_note.description: An early explanatory passage contains conflicting prose about the sign of GEX. The implemented code consistently treats rising grad_norm relative to EMA as positive GEX and responds by lowering lr_scale.
historical_training_note.provenance_rule: Preserve the early contradiction rather than silently normalizing the historical text.

routing_rule: Require source-level context before routing GEX to a namespace.
A cultural analogy may be stored as SYMBOLIC_RELATION only and must not inherit runtime authority.
A training heuristic must not inherit biographical/game claims from the Hall of Honor node.
